parameters.content:
### {{CLINIC_NAME}} - Prescription Management & Refill Reminder System (PET WF13)

**🎯 Purpose:** Complete prescription lifecycle management with automated refill reminders and comprehensive tracking

**🚀 Key Features:**

**Prescription Entry System:**
• **Staff Form Interface:** Easy-to-use form for logging new prescriptions
• **Comprehensive Data Capture:** Patient info, medication details, refill authorization
• **Automatic Calculations:** Auto-calculates next refill due dates
• **Real-time Logging:** Instant entry into prescription tracking system
• **Vet Notifications:** Automatic confirmation emails to prescribing veterinarian

**Smart Refill Management:**
• **Daily Monitoring:** Automated daily checks for refill eligibility
• **Intelligent Filtering:** Advanced logic to identify refill candidates
• **Timeline Tracking:** Monitors days supply and refill timing
• **Status Management:** Tracks active vs inactive prescriptions
• **Refill Counting:** Decrements remaining refills automatically

**Automated Client Communication:**
• **Proactive Reminders:** SMS alerts 5 days before medication runs out
• **Urgent Notifications:** Special handling for same-day medication depletion
• **Personalized Messages:** Custom messages with pet name and medication details
• **Refill Status Updates:** Clear indication of remaining refills
• **Professional Branding:** Branded messages with clinic contact information

**Comprehensive Tracking:**
• **Prescription Database:** Complete log of all prescriptions in Google Sheets
• **Contact History:** Tracks all reminder communications
• **Reminder Analytics:** Counts and timestamps for all contact attempts
• **Status Updates:** Real-time status tracking and notes
• **Audit Trail:** Complete record of prescription lifecycle

**⚡ Dual Workflow Process:**

**Part A: New Prescription Entry (On-Demand)**
1. **Form Submission:** Staff enters prescription details via secure form
2. **Data Validation:** System validates and formats all prescription data
3. **Database Logging:** Creates permanent record in prescription tracking sheet
4. **Vet Notification:** Sends detailed confirmation email to prescribing veterinarian
5. **Refill Setup:** Automatically calculates and schedules refill timeline

**Part B: Automated Refill Reminders (Daily)**
1. **Daily Trigger:** Runs every morning at 10 AM to check all prescriptions
2. **Data Retrieval:** Pulls complete prescription database from Google Sheets
3. **Smart Filtering:** Analyzes each prescription for refill eligibility:
   - Checks refills remaining
   - Calculates days until medication runs out
   - Identifies prescriptions needing 5-day advance notice
   - Flags urgent same-day notifications
4. **SMS Delivery:** Sends personalized refill reminders to pet owners
5. **Database Updates:** Logs all reminder activity and contact history

**🔍 Advanced Logic Features:**
• **Days Supply Calculation:** Precise tracking of medication duration
• **Refill Eligibility:** Smart filtering based on remaining refills
• **Urgency Detection:** Special handling for urgent refill needs
• **Contact Optimization:** Prevents duplicate reminders
• **Error Handling:** Graceful handling of data inconsistencies

**📊 Prescription Categories:**
• **Active Prescriptions:** Currently valid with refills available
• **Refill Due:** Medications running low (5 days or less remaining)
• **Urgent Refill:** Medications running out today
• **No Refills:** Prescriptions requiring new vet authorization

**🔔 Communication Types:**
• **Standard Reminder:** 5-day advance notice for refill preparation
• **Urgent Alert:** Same-day notification for immediate action
• **Refill Status:** Clear indication of remaining refills available
• **Contact Instructions:** Direct clinic contact information

**🔄 Integration Points:**
• Prescription Hub: {{PRESCRIPTION_SHEET_ID}}
• Staff Form: prescription-form-{{CLINIC_ID}}
• Veterinarian: {{VET_EMAIL}}
• SMS Service: {{BUSINESS_PHONE_NUMBER}}
• Business Contact: {{BUSINESS_EMAIL}}

**⚙️ Configuration:**
• Clinic: {{CLINIC_NAME}}
• Prescription Sheet: {{PRESCRIPTION_SHEET_NAME}}
• Timezone: {{TIMEZONE}}
• Daily Check Time: 10:00 AM
• Reminder Threshold: 5 days advance notice
• Brand Color: {{CLINIC_COLOR}}
